sources.entry: OmniFocus - Nice GTD app, made by OmniGroups.

summary.name: OmniFocus
summary.one_liner: OmniFocus is task management software from The Omni Group for busy professionals, built around capturing tasks quickly and organizing them into projects, perspectives, and forecasts.
use_cases: organize work into projects and tags
plan the week with due dates and forecast
run a weekly review of projects
summary.what_it_does: OmniFocus lets users capture tasks into an Inbox with a keyboard shortcut and organize them into projects using tagging and due dates. A Forecast view shows upcoming work, and custom Perspectives group similar actions together. A to-do list tracks priorities and suggests the next task to focus on. Weekly review features help keep projects up to date, and the app syncs across Apple devices and to the web version for PC use.
notable: Forecast view showing upcoming tasks and deadlines
Custom Perspectives to group similar actions
Deep integration with macOS and iOS notifications
Syncs across Apple devices and a web version for PC users
caveats: Requires recent Apple OS versions (macOS 15.2, iOS/iPadOS 18.2) for current releases; older Macs may need an archived earlier version
Web version requires a web browser with JavaScript and an active connection
Pricing not stated on the page
